scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && electron-builder --win --linux --mac --publish never && node scripts/copy-installers.cjs
scripts.run:win: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Test-Path 'release\win-unpacked\My UML Multi OS.exe')) { npm run build:win }; Start-Process -FilePath 'release\win-unpacked\My UML Multi OS.exe'"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
